claim_boundary: This is multi-view canonical street-name recognition Development evidence on pre-cropped signs. FSNS provides the canonical label for the sample but not exhaustive pixel text, per-tile target boxes, camera poses, action labels, metric distance, facade association, entrance or portal ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, deployment, or safety. Canonical-label-disjoint challenges are collision diagnostics, not a pixel-absence false-positive rate. Multiple views are observations from different positions/times, not evidence that an L10-selected action caused the recovery. UNKNOWN is neither negative nor known-safe; no conformal, FDR, or open-world guarantee is claimed.
